dsDescriptionValue.value: Interview with Kate van Lookeren Campagne at the Rijksmuseum Ateliergebouw in Amsterdam. Kate discusses her training and experiences in glass and ceramics conservation and how her career developed.

fields.value: Interview conducted in the context of the course Oral History and Artwork Life Stories at the University of Amsterdam, an elective as part of the Conservation and Restoration of Cultural Heritage programme.
